assign.card: Drawer: tight header, one scroll area, footer at the bottom

log.msg: task-mastermind-drawer-cleanup its agent is not running; a revive is queued

decision.question: why was the drawer's scroll/footer broken — a missing height cap, or something else?
options: keep tuning max-block-size caps on the thread/card flex chain
decision.chose: found the actual overflowing element: the AI tab's closed session-switcher list was rendering at ~940px despite `hidden`
decision.why: its `.flex` utility class (@layer util) silently beat the `[hidden]` rule (@layer theme, css skill rule 3) — the exact same unfixed trap already sat, unnoticed, on `.drawer-inbox[hidden]`. Fixed both with `!important`; the flex chain underneath was already correct once this one object stopped lying about its own size.

decision.question: how should the composer footer reach the drawer's true bottom edge?
options: negative margin-block-end on the composer, matching .drawer's own padding
decision.why: negative margin-block-end was tried first and measured wrong: `.drawer-body` is `overflow: auto`, and a descendant's negative margin that bleeds past a clipping ancestor just becomes dead scrollable space (measured 14px of it), never a visually flush edge.

experiment.try: probe computed styles/rects live via Server/browser.mjs (headless, no popup) after each CSS change, instead of reasoning from source alone
experiment.measure: .drawer-body scrollHeight vs clientHeight; header/session/composer rects before and after scrolling a real ~4000px thread to its top and bottom
experiment.result: scrollHeight === clientHeight (no stray overflow); header/session/composer rects identical before and after scrolling either direction

assign.title: Drawer: a [hidden] bug, not a missing cap — scroll and footer fixed
assign.outcome:
**Fixed.** Root cause: the closed session-switcher list rendered at ~940px because its `.flex` class beat `[hidden]` — it pushed the composer off-screen and forced the whole body to scroll.

- [x] header hugs, body is the ONLY scroll box, footer stays put via flex-grow: proved live — scrolling a real 4000px thread leaves header/footer rects unchanged (after-1920-thread-top.png, after-1920-thread-bottom.png)
- [x] footer full width, flush, `--wash`, one `var(--pad)`, no border: after-1920-drawer.png vs before-3440-drawer.png
- [x] unknown space killed: the switcher's phantom 940px block is gone (`.drawer-ai-switch-list[hidden]` now `!important`)
- [x] screenshots at 400/1200/1920/3440: after-400/1200/1920/3440-drawer.png — nothing overlaps

reviewed: pass (size none — single-file root-cause fix, proven by probe). Doc: [decisions.md](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/decisions/).
